Plugin.Name: Fusion-io Driver
Plugin.Overview: Driver and management for Fusion-io / SanDisk ioDrive, ioDrive2, ioScale and ioScale2 PCIe flash cards. Unraid has no driver for these cards; this plugin loads the community iomemory-vsl (VSL3) driver built for your exact Unraid version and adds a "Fusion-io Devices" section to the Main tab: card temperature and power, mount/unmount, auto mount, format (XFS/BTRFS), and a per-card switch to use a card in the array or a cache pool. A Dashboard tile shows the cards at a glance. Not for newer ioMemory SX300/SX350/PX600 cards (VSL4). Unofficial driver: test before trusting it with important data.
